Oliver R.: FinServX requests Private POC: no internet egress from inference hosts, preserve client source IP, strict firewall allowlist. Need quick topology rec and cost.
Anna S.: Clarify: customer-managed egress proxy allowed?
Oliver R.: They prefer zero egress; control plane ok over PrivateLink or transit.
Marc P.: PrivateLink = simplest allowlist (vpce ENI IPs) but loses client src IP. TGW/peering preserves src if we attach VPC or use pass-through appliance.
Jai N.: If src IP required, recommend TGW + VPC attachment or customer proxy that preserves src. PrivateLink will show endpoint ENI as source unless app adds X-Forwarded-For.
Sarah L.: Compliance: confirm SOC2 scope, KMS integration, log retention, and whether HSM/FIPS is required. Suggest logs land in customer's S3.
Anna S.: Sample allowlist: TCP 443 -> vpce-<id> for control plane; TCP 8443 between app and inference pool; TCP 10256 health checks. Provide SG snippet.
Marc P.: I'll prepare a one-pager diagram with PrivateLink and TGW variants + pros/cons and allowlists.
Jai N.: I'll validate SG and route table snippets and give minimal TGW route example.
Anna S.: Pricing ballpark: Dedicated 2 mid GPUs ~ $12k/mo; Private platform license ~ $6k/mo; conservative POC estimate ~$18k/mo. Final depends on GPU class and network pattern.
Oliver R.: Need diagram, allowlist, pricing and compliance checklist by EOD tomorrow for FinServX security 10am PT.
ploy-bot: created DOC-1765001234-sales-handshake.md (link: https://redwood.internal/docs/1765001234) :white_check_mark:
Oliver R.: Thanks team, short thread for customer.
